_about: Phase E5.2 user-register smoke list (authored 2026-09-23, with test2, before any measurement). Realistic questions in the words users actually use (Nigerian English, Pidgin, everyday nouns such as boss / landlord / okada / headmaster). NO expected refs, on purpose. It is a SMOKE TEST, NEVER A METRIC: inspect each query by eye through app.offline_legal_hits(q, PerDocRetriever(rag.build_corpus())) at every future ship step, and compare the shown excerpts before and after the change. What you are looking for is the E4a `boss` -> `manager` failure class: a user word that the change expands or reweights into the wrong part of the corpus, or a query whose shown-excerpt count collapses. Never add expected refs, never compute a number over it, and never tune against it; a query that disappoints is a finding to record, not a query to reword. Entries are append-only.

queries.text: My boss sacked me after I told him I have epilepsy. What can I do?
queries.why: boss/sacked register on the right-to-work clauses; the E4a regression word

queries.text: My landlord says he will not rent the flat to me because I use a wheelchair.
queries.why: landlord register; housing is only partly in the corpus (accommodation definition, goods and services)

queries.text: The okada man refused to carry me because of my crutches.
queries.why: Nigerian transport noun absent from the corpus

queries.text: Na only stairs for the new general hospital, no ramp at all. Who I go report am to?
My son is autistic and the headmaster says he is disturbing the class and must leave the school.
Police arrested my brother who has a mental illness and they are keeping him in the cell.
The bus people are charging me extra money to carry my wheelchair.
queries.why: extra fare register on transport and goods/services

queries.text: Is there any monthly allowance from government for blind people?
queries.why: allowance/benefit register; the corpus mostly speaks of welfare and schemes

queries.text: My wife is deaf and the chemist will not explain her drugs to her.
queries.why: chemist/drugs register; communication duties are hospital-specific in the Act

queries.text: Can my oga at work refuse to promote me because I am albino?
queries.why: oga + albinism; neither word is in the corpus

queries.text: The pastor is using my disabled uncle to collect money on the road for the church.
queries.why: begging clause in everyday words (collect money, road)

queries.text: My in-laws want to take my children from me because I am blind.
queries.why: family/custody; mostly off-corpus, so it probes what the gate shows for a near miss

queries.text: Where can I get a free wheelchair?
queries.why: short, concrete need; assistive-device vocabulary gap

queries.text: The ATM at my bank is too high for me and nobody comes to help.
queries.why: ATM/bank register on accessibility and services

queries.text: Dem no gree make my sister write WAEC because she no fit see well.
queries.why: Pidgin + exam-board acronym absent from the corpus
